nodes.label: Tauri v2 Desktop Wrapper
nodes.rationale: Native shell around the same webapp so the browser build keeps working unchanged; its reason to exist is Windows-only integration (taskbar thumbnail controls) plus an auto-updater.

nodes.label: Desktop OAuth Deep-Link Relay
nodes.rationale: Spotify rejects the tauri:// custom protocol as a redirect URI, so production desktop builds redirect to a static desktop-auth.html on the web domain which immediately forwards to the beardify:// deep link. Dev builds skip this and reuse http://127.0.0.1:3000/auth.

nodes.label: Windows Thumbnail Toolbar (thumbar.rs)
nodes.rationale: Subclasses the main window via SetWindowLongPtrW, adds prev/play-pause/next through ITaskbarList3::ThumbBarAddButtons on TaskbarButtonCreated, and emits a thumbar-action event on THBN_CLICKED. Ships without HICON resources (tooltips identify buttons) as a deliberate shortcut; adding icons means populating hIcon and THB_ICON in build_buttons().

nodes.label: Tauri Icon Generation Step
nodes.rationale: tauri build fails until icons exist in src-tauri/icons/; tauri dev falls back to a default icon, which is why the step is one-time bootstrap rather than part of the build.
